name: Cumbuco Guesthouse
summary: A guesthouse with air-conditioned rooms, breakfast, garden-facing balconies, pool, hydromassage, and help arranging local activities.
descriptionHtml:
Cumbuco Guesthouse offers air-conditioned rooms with private bathrooms, breakfast, Wi-Fi, and balconies. Its official website also presents a pool, hydromassage, airport transfers, buggy arrangements, and kite lessons through local providers.

Confirm current room types, rates, transfer prices, and activity arrangements directly before booking.

location.address: Rua G, 199, Praia do Cumbuco, Caucaia, Ceará
